entities.name: Old Stickfingers
aliases: Aval, the Vine Lord of the Hearth
entities.description: An ancient horror of Innistrad, once a forgotten nature god, summoned as a hearth spirit to protect a property.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Farmer who invoked Old Stickfingers to protect his property; possibly possessed by it.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: Arinos's daughter, who with Vadrik contained Old Stickfingers by completing the ritual.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Cathar called in to investigate the deaths.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Archmage who investigated and contained Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Village where Old Stickfingers killed several people.

events.summary: Arinos invokes Old Stickfingers but the ritual is incomplete, so it kills several people in Lambholt.
events.quote: causing Old Stickfingers to kill several people across the village of Lambholt

events.summary: Rem Karolus and Vadrik are called to investigate the deaths.
events.quote: The cathar Rem Karolus and the archmage Vadrik were called in to investigate the mysterious deaths.

events.summary: Vadrik and Ariosa contain Old Stickfingers by completing the ritual.
events.quote: managed to contain Old Stickfingers by completing the ritual
